# James Coombs

> Staff UX Engineer / UI Architect | Bridging design systems, web performance, and AI platform tooling at scale.

## Context & Core Technical Focus
- **Product & Growth Engineering**: Architecting fast, data-driven web experiences that optimize conversion, SEO, and user engagement.
- **Platform & Developer Experience**: Building the infrastructure that lets engineering organizations ship faster, including automated component migration tooling and codified governance.
- **Design & Craft**: Scaling headless component systems (Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, Astro, React) and ensuring design intent survives implementation.
- **Performance Engineering**: DOM rendering optimizations, script execution reductions, and Core Web Vitals (INP, LCP) overhauls.

## Key Case Studies
- [SEO Landing Page Engine](https://james-coombs.com/case-studies/): Built a dynamic landing page generation engine leveraging Next.js API routes, Algolia, Cloudinary, and GitLab CI/CD, empowering the business to deploy data-driven shopping experiences at scale without manual engineering intervention.
- [Signup Performance Overhaul](https://james-coombs.com/case-studies/): Split the signup webpack bundle, removed blocking dependencies, and established a frozen performance baseline. Drove signup LCP p75 from 9.8s down to 3.19s (-67%) with render delay from 8.4s to 2.6s, monitored via 7 RUM dashboards and 6 production alerts.
- [Design System and Migration Engine](https://james-coombs.com/case-studies/): Built a suite of 12 custom CLI tools and 48 JSON data files to automate the codebase transition of 962 files, alongside a 60-component design system. Cut legacy Material UI files from 999 to 792 while growing Design System files to 508, purging 275 files (-18.7 MB unpacked).

## Other Infrastructure & Tooling
- [Agentic AI Governance Layer](https://james-coombs.com/blog/ai-agent-safety-architecture/): Codified safety system for AI agents enforcing runtime hooks across 1,802 lines and 13 scripts, backed by 219 tests and 1,251 manual approvals.
- [High-Performance Transcript Rendering Engine](https://james-coombs.com/resume/#rev): Architectural overhaul to performance engineering resulting in the deployment of RUM regression alerting across the highest-traffic pages.
